items.title: Micron Stock Could Close Above $1,000. Why It’s Not What It Seems.
items.summary: Investors on Friday were pushing shares of  Micron Technology  toward closing above $1,000 for the first time since mid-August following the release of OpenAI’s latest artificial-intelligence model and as the AI-trade picked up momentum.  Micron stock advanced 4.4% to $1,000.50 on Friday, and shares of the memory-chip company were on pace to end the week up more than 7%.  If Micron stock closes above $1,000 on Friday, it will be the first time shares have closed at that level since Aug. 17, according to Dow Jones Market Data.
